note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Kind, roadmap phase, missable flags, guidance and sources were added by this guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guidance: The platinum. It pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat every other trophy on this list as a step toward it. Use the roadmap view to work through the phases in order and the platinum will be the last thing that unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guidance: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story trophy and cannot be missed: it unlocks as soon as the introduction is over and free roam begins.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guidance: Play through Chapter 1 of the story to its end. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as you progress, so no special setup is needed — just keep following the story markers.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guidance: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies this one is unmissable — it pops when the chapter's final mission ends. While you are in this part of the story, start any stranger strands you meet so they do not pile up later.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guidance: Finish Chapter 3. Unmissable story progression. By this point the map opens up, so it is a good time to bank a few activity and collectible trophies between story missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guidance: Finish Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. Before you push into the endgame, clear the partner trophies and any open stranger strands — the roadmap flags which ones to finish first.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guidance: Complete the final story mission. This gold trophy marks the end of the main story. The game continues in free roam afterwards, but partner-dependent trophies are safest done before this point — see the missable flags on Hot Together and Retail Therapy.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guidance: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the main story line, so it unlocks naturally as you play through the early chapters.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guidance: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the main story — stock up on armour and ammo beforehand, then play it through to the end for the trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guidance: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another main-story mission trophy that unlocks automatically when the mission is finished.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guidance: Complete the story mission Headliners. Part of the main story; no extra conditions — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guidance: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Keep an eye out during this mission for the related missable trophy Catch Me If You Can, which asks for an unscheduled departure at VCIA — that moment only exists inside this part of the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guidance: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A late-story mission trophy that unlocks on completion, like the other named-mission trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guidance: Reach 100% completion. This gold trophy is the long grind at the end of the roadmap: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges all feed the completion percentage, so leave it until the cleanup phase and use the in-game stats screen to see what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guidance: Pull off 250 stunts in total. Stunts accumulate across the whole game, so this silver trophy rewards simply driving boldly everywhere: use ramps, jumps and near-misses whenever you travel, and the counter will climb on its own. Check the stats screen to see your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guidance: Try every activity type at least once — the official list counts 9 activity types. As new activity icons appear on the map, dip into each one briefly; you only need to try them, not master them. This is a good early checklist item while exploring.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guidance: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total, per the official list. Work through them range by range, replaying any challenge that only scored silver or bronze. Short, controlled bursts and learning each course layout are the fastest route to gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guidance: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. You need one win per location, not a win in every race, so retry a course until you take first place, then move on to the next marker.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guidance: Win 20 different races. 'Different' is the key word — winning the same race 20 times does not count, so spread your wins across distinct race events. A tuned car in each vehicle class makes this much easier.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guidance: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the side activities; once you have unlocked it and met Cal, take on his challenge and out-fish him to pop this trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guidance: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, play a game through to its end (win or finish), and the trophy unlocks. One of the quickest trophies on the list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Andy's strand is a multi-mission side story. Finish each of his missions as they appear and complete the strand before the endgame, in case the strand locks after late story beats.
trophies.guidance: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands unfold over several meetings, so return to Andy whenever his marker reappears and play the strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_note: Kenton's strand runs over several missions. Work through it whenever his marker appears and finish the strand before the finale so it cannot lock.
trophies.guidance: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger strand. Keep checking back on Kenton after each mission in his strand until the last one is done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_note: Billy's strand is a multi-part side story. Complete each part as it becomes available and finish the strand before the endgame.
trophies.guidance: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger strand. Follow Billy's marker through every part of his strand until the concluding mission is complete.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Needs 8 completed stranger strands. Individual strands can lock if ignored through major story beats, so finish strands as they appear instead of leaving them all to the end.
trophies.guidance: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) all count toward this silver trophy, so finishing those plus a few more stranger encounters will get you there.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Randy's strand spans several missions. Complete it in step with the story and finish before the finale so the strand cannot lock.
trophies.guidance: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger strand. Return to Randy each time his strand continues until you have played its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_note: Tyrone's strand is multi-part. Finish each part as it appears and complete the strand before the endgame.
trophies.guidance: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger strand. Follow the strand through all of its parts until the final mission is done.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guidance: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 spots in total. They are scattered across the state, so tick them off as you explore each region rather than hunting them all at the end. The stats screen tracks how many you have found.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missable_note: Tied to Bret's hunting strand. Start Bret's strand when it appears and complete the unique-animal hunt before the endgame.
trophies.guidance: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This comes from Bret's side strand: take on his hunting request, track down the specific animal he asks for, and bring the hunt to a successful end.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guidance: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; you need three full sets, not every set in the game. Pick the sets you are closest to finishing and sweep their remaining cards during the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guidance: WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This silver trophy is a pure exploration grind: use the WAiNK feature whenever you reach a new landmark or viewpoint, and the locations will add up across the whole map.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guidance: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the short objective tasks tracked in the game's menus; there are more than 50 available, so pick the ones that suit your play style and clear them in batches during free roam.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: Requires your partner to be with you. Do this while your partner is available during the story — before the final mission — rather than leaving it to post-story free roam.
trophies.guidance: With your partner alongside, raise your wanted level to 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat fully clears. A fast car, a change of vehicle out of sight, and staying off main roads all help you lose the police.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: Requires your partner. Rob the three shops in one run while your partner is available, before the final mission, and keep the wanted level active between robberies.
trophies.guidance: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without your wanted level ever dropping to zero. Plan a route between nearby shops, keep moving so the stars stay up, and finish the third robbery before escaping. Pairs naturally with Hot Together.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guidance: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new model you drive or encounter up close counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar whenever you see it. Vehicle variety in different districts and at different times of day speeds this up.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guidance: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Save the ability for a crowded firefight, position so several enemies are in view at once, then trigger Combat Focus and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: Tied to the VCIA sequence in the story (see the VCIA Takedown mission). Make the unscheduled departure during that part of the story — the moment does not exist outside it, so do not rush past the VCIA section without attempting it.
trophies.guidance: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a story-moment trophy connected to the VCIA Takedown mission: when the story puts you at VCIA, leave in an unscheduled way rather than following the planned exit.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guidance: Deal with Rhinos — the game's tanks. The description is deliberately cryptic ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'), so expect this to involve getting into or taking on a Rhino tank. Military hardware appears at high wanted levels and around restricted areas; experiment when you find one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guidance: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Scout the store first, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and only start the robbery when you can reach the cases unseen. If you are spotted, leave and try again clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guidance: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault robberies are the heavyweight heists of free roam: bring armour, a fast getaway car parked nearby, and a planned escape route. Escaping means fully losing the wanted level, so budget time for the getaway after every vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guidance: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads; block one in, take its cash, then lose the police. A sticky bomb or heavy weapon stops the truck quickly, but keep a getaway vehicle close.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guidance: Explore all of Leonida — the official list counts 52 areas. You need to visit every region of the state, so systematically sweep the map district by district, including the outlying islands and rural areas, until no area is left unvisited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guidance: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total. Every gang runs at least one illegal operation somewhere in Leonida; find one per gang, rob it, and escape. Track which gangs you have done so you do not repeat the same one.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missable_note: An early-game moment on Ocean Beach. Do it during the opening hours of the game while you are first exploring Ocean Beach, rather than assuming the moment stays available forever.
trophies.guidance: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Early in the game, head to Ocean Beach, find a spot serving cocktails overlooking the water, and take the moment in — a small, easy trophy that sets the tone for Leonida.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guidance: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get inside a vehicle showroom, take a car, and drive it out through the showroom frontage in the most dramatic way possible. Expect a wanted level — have an escape route ready.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guidance: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throw. Visit the alley, play a game of bowling, and complete a proper follow-through shot to unlock it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: A partnership trophy — it involves your partner. Attempt it while your partner is available during the story, before the final mission.
trophies.guidance: A partnership with mass appeal. This cryptic trophy involves you and your partner doing something with broad appeal together. While your partner is travelling with you, try shared activities and public moments together and watch for the unlock.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: Built on choices made across the story. Engage with choice moments throughout the campaign instead of skipping them; a playthrough that avoids choices may not reach the required count.
trophies.guidance: Make choices — for better or worse. The game tracks the decisions you make during the story, and this trophy rewards engaging with them rather than avoiding them. When the game offers a choice, take one; the count builds across the whole campaign.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: A 'second time' moment: failing or losing something once, then succeeding on the retry. If a story moment offers a second attempt, take it instead of reloading away from it.
trophies.guidance: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on your second attempt after a first failure. When an activity or encounter goes wrong, retry it straight away rather than reloading — the comeback is what this trophy is counting.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: A one-off strange encounter. Explore off the beaten path during the story and investigate anything odd you stumble across; random encounters may not repeat.
trophies.guidance: Witness something strange — the description ('What the hell just happened?') points to one of Leonida's odd encounters. Explore remote and unusual places, and when something bizarre happens in front of you, stick around to see it through.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guidance: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, lean out and strike a pedestrian with a melee weapon so they go down like a bowling pin. A slow pass on a quiet street gives you the cleanest shot at it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guidance: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from criminal work; pass them through your contacts to clean them, and keep laundering until your total earnings from it reach $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guidance: Spend $100,000 in shops in total. Weapons, clothes, vehicle upgrades and property purchases all add up — this usually unlocks naturally during a full playthrough, especially once you start buying garages and high-end gear.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guidance: Purchase every garage property — 8 in total. Garages double as safe vehicle storage, so buying them all is useful as well as required. Save up from heists and businesses, then buy each garage as it becomes available.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guidance: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a new vehicle, register it in the app straight away; ten registrations unlock the trophy. Pairs well with Whip It Good, which asks you to discover 100 vehicles.
